title: Grateful Dead Live at Utica Memorial Auditorium on 1973-03-22
source: 10" Betty Board Reel > PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 optical S/PDIF out (Jace's Tape) > disk

ai_review.summary: Decent 1973 performance but the recording falls short of a better‑sounding, more complete source
ai_review.review: Reviewers note that this is a typical good ’73 show, yet they point out that another tape from the same date sounds clearer and includes more material. The soundboard capture here is serviceable but not as crisp or complete as the preferred alternative.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it calls the show decent but criticizes the recording quality, leading to an average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not as clear or complete as another available recording; likely missing portions and less crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a typical good 1973 show with no specific issues noted.
